snippet.title: Element Cattos 0.12.1 release trailer
snippet.description:
Download it here! https://oberorka.itch.io/elementcattos
The first public version is finally here after a lot of playtesting in the Discord server. It's still a work in progress, so let me know about any oddities you find or any suggestions you have! It only saves me work fixing more bugs later lol
